remoteplay.title: Remote play
remoteplay.explain: Play a friend's game as player 2. Their game streams to this device and you play with your controller, on the same Wi-Fi or online with a code. Only the stream runs here, so you don't need the game. To host, start a game, open the in-game menu, tap Friends, then Host on this Wi-Fi or Invite online. The stream goes straight between the two devices, with no server in between, so how well it plays depends on both connections and how far apart you are. Both devices need the same version of ARMSX2.
remoteplay.join.codeHint: Enter the code your friend gave you, or paste the invite they sent.
remoteplay.join.badCode: That isn't a code or an invite. Check it and try again.
remoteplay.join.notFound: No game with that code. Codes last 10 minutes, so ask your friend for a new one.
remoteplay.join.title: Friends hosting on this Wi-Fi
remoteplay.join.searching: Looking for friends hosting a game...
remoteplay.join.scanHint: Looks for friends hosting on this Wi-Fi for up to a minute, then stops by itself.
remoteplay.screen.title: When you join a friend
remoteplay.screen.note: These only change your screen while you play a friend's game as player 2. They do nothing when you host.
remoteplay.screen.exitDesc: A Leave button at the top of the screen. With tap to reveal, tap the top middle of the screen to show it. Back on your device or Home on your controller always works too.
remoteplay.screen.touchDesc: Your ARMSX2 touch controls, with your own layout and skin, for when you don't have a controller. With tap to reveal, tap the screen to show them. They hide again when you use a controller.
remoteplay.screen.statsDesc: Frame rate, delay and connection details in a corner of the screen while you play.
remoteplay.screen.qosDesc: Asks your friend's device to mark the stream as video, so routers that sort traffic send it from their video queue. On some networks that means fewer hitches; it also adds about 25 ms of delay. Same Wi-Fi only, and nothing to set on your friend's side.
remoteplay.join.howToHost: To host, start a game, open the in-game menu, tap Friends, then Host on this Wi-Fi or Invite online.
remoteplay.host.explain: Let a friend play as player 2. Your game streams to their device and they play with their own controller. On the same Wi-Fi they find you by themselves; online, send them an invite. The stream goes straight between the two devices, with no server in between, so how well it plays depends on both connections and how far apart you are. Both devices need the same version of ARMSX2.
remoteplay.host.waiting: Waiting for a friend. They can find you under Remote play in their library menu.
remoteplay.host.address: Or they can join by address: %s
remoteplay.host.noGame: Start a game to host it.
remoteplay.host.noNetwork: Couldn't start hosting. Check that Wi-Fi is on.
remoteplay.host.failed: Remote play stopped because of a connection problem. Try again.
remoteplay.invite.lobbyCode: Your friend enters this code in ARMSX2, under Remote play, Join with a code:
remoteplay.invite.lobbyWaiting: Waiting for your friend to join...
remoteplay.invite.lobbyShare: Play with me on ARMSX2! Open ARMSX2, go to Remote play in the menu, and enter this code under Join with a code: %s
remoteplay.invite.expired: The invite expired without anyone joining. Create a new one.
remoteplay.invite.step1: 1. Send this invite to your friend.
remoteplay.invite.step2: 2. Paste the reply they send back, then tap Connect.
remoteplay.invite.badReply: That isn't a reply code. Ask your friend to send the reply from their Remote play screen.
remoteplay.invite.share:
Play with me on ARMSX2! Open ARMSX2, go to Remote play in the menu, and paste this whole message under Join with a code:

%s
remoteplay.reply.share:
Here's my ARMSX2 reply. Paste this whole message into Remote play, then tap Connect:

%s
remoteplay.viewer.sendReply: Send this reply to your friend, then come back here. You connect as soon as they paste it.
remoteplay.viewer.waitingHost: Waiting for your friend to paste your reply...
remoteplay.viewer.hint: You're player 2. Press Back or Home to leave.
remoteplay.viewer.hintExit: Tap the top middle of the screen for the exit button.
remoteplay.viewer.hintTouch: Tap the screen for touch controls.
remoteplay.viewer.hintTouchElsewhere: Tap anywhere else for touch controls.
remoteplay.viewer.leaveButtons: A to leave, B to keep playing
remoteplay.viewer.lost: Lost the connection to the host.
remoteplay.timeout.viewer: Your friend didn't connect in time. Ask them for a new invite.
remoteplay.timeout.host: Couldn't connect to your friend. Some networks block direct connections. Try again, or play on the same Wi-Fi.
remoteplay.error.connect: Couldn't reach that device. Make sure the host has started the game and you're on the same Wi-Fi.
remoteplay.error.lobby: Couldn't reach the remote play service. Check your internet connection.
remoteplay.bye.busy: Someone else is already playing as player 2 there.
remoteplay.bye.version: That device has a different version of ARMSX2. Update both to the same version.
remoteplay.permission.host: Hosting on the same Wi-Fi needs the Nearby devices permission. Allow it when asked, or under Permissions in this app's settings. You can still invite a friend online.
remoteplay.permission.join: Finding a friend on the same Wi-Fi needs the Nearby devices permission. Allow it when asked, or under Permissions in this app's settings. You can still join with a code.
remoteplay.request.title: %s wants to join as player 2
remoteplay.viewer.waitingAccept: Connected. Waiting for your friend to let you in...
remoteplay.bye.noAnswer: Your friend didn't answer in time.
